thread:
sasha: Quick flag from today's onboarding lab: README examples are tripping people.
sasha: Multiline curl with backslashes fails in PowerShell and some terminals. Also examples use `REDWOOD_KEY` while SDK expects `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
kevin: Yikes. Can you paste the problematic snippet?
sasha: Sure:
```
curl \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
kevin: Fixes: (1) switch to a single-line curl or mark it as bash only, (2) add a PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod example, (3) standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY across all samples.
kevin: Also TS snippet uses default import which fails for strict TS configs. I'll add both `import RedwoodClient from` and `import { RedwoodClient }` variants and note esModuleInterop.
sasha: Great. Can we add a tiny docs smoke script that checks examples use REDWOOD_API_KEY and runs a node example (no network) in CI?
mira: I'll open a PR for the README + examples and add the CI smoke check.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/731 10 edits (curl, PowerShell, env var parity, TS import note).
sasha: Thanks! I'll review the PR after lunch. :thumbsup:
